SELECT B.BUSI_ID id, IFNULL(C.FINPROD_NAME, B.BUSI_ID) text FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT A LEFT JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID B ON A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND A.BUSI_ID = B.BUSI_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON B.BUSI_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND B.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE = C.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE A.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE IN ('QTYSK_BJ', 'QTYSK_LX')
AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{bookSetId}
AND (B.BUSI_ID like concat_ws('','%' , #{search} , '%') OR C.FINPROD_NAME like concat_ws('','%' , #{search} , '%'))
GROUP BY B.BUSI_ID, B.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, C.FINPROD_NAME ORDER BY B.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, B.BUSI_ID
